h1: AI and Intake Automation for Law Firms: Answer Every Lead, Sign More Cases
lede: We build AI intake agents that answer calls, texts and website chats in seconds, day and night, then connect them to your CRM, calendar and follow-up so every lead is qualified, booked and tracked without adding staff.

answer.question: What is AI intake automation for law firms?
answer.text: AI intake automation for law firms uses AI agents and connected workflows to answer every inquiry instantly, ask the firm's intake questions, book consultations and follow up automatically. It runs 24/7 under attorney supervision, never gives legal advice, and logs every conversation in the firm's CRM so no lead is missed.

sections.h2: AI agents that answer every lead, day and night
paragraphs: Most leads that go cold were never answered in the first place. A call at 9 p.m., a web form on Sunday, a text while the receptionist is on another line. We build AI intake agents that respond in seconds on the phone, by text and in website chat. They greet the caller, ask your intake questions, screen for practice area, location and conflicts, and book a consultation straight onto the right attorney's calendar or hand off to a person when it matters.

Every agent works from scripts your firm approves, in your firm's voice. It never gives legal advice, it says clearly that it is an automated assistant, and it escalates emergencies, existing clients and anything sensitive to a human right away. You get a transcript and summary of every conversation in your CRM, so your team walks into each consult already knowing the story.

We map the path a lead takes from first contact to signed retainer, then build it into your CRM so nothing depends on memory. That means lead sources tagged correctly, intake stages that match how your firm actually works, and automated text and email follow-up that fires when a caller does not book. We work with the intake and practice management tools legal teams commonly use, and we help you choose one if your current setup is a spreadsheet.

Automation should support your people, not replace the human conversation a scared client needs. We write follow-up sequences in plain language, keep them compliant with the attorney advertising rules in your state, and set clear handoffs to a live intake specialist or attorney. Your team gets task reminders, missed-call alerts and a daily view of which leads are waiting, so the right person calls back while the prospect still wants to talk.

sections.h2: AI integration for your team, not just your intake
paragraphs: The same tools can take hours of routine work off your staff each week. We set up AI that drafts consult summaries and follow-up emails, keeps CRM records current, sends plain-language case status updates, requests reviews at the right moments and flags leads that have gone quiet. Your people review and approve; the busywork disappears.

We build with confidentiality and professional responsibility first. That means tools with proper data protections, no client information used to train public models, attorney review of anything client-facing, and setups that follow ABA guidance on generative AI and your state bar's rules. You own every workflow, agent and prompt we build, and we document them so your firm is never locked in.

practice_notes.text: Contingency case acquisition rewards the firm that responds first and gathers accident facts fast. We build intake that screens liability, injuries and insurance in the first call.
Arrests happen at night and family members call in a panic. We set up 24/7 answering, clear bail and court date questions, and instant attorney alerts.
Divorce and custody callers are emotional and often researching quietly. Intake focuses on discretion, safe contact preferences and a fast path to a paid consult.
Prospects take weeks or months to decide. We build longer nurture sequences, seminar follow-up and referral partner tracking instead of pushing for a same-day booking.

faqs.q: What can AI agents do for a law firm?
faqs.a: AI agents can answer calls, texts and website chats 24/7, ask your intake questions, screen for practice area and location, book consultations and log everything in your CRM. Behind the scenes they can draft consult summaries, client updates and follow-up emails for your staff to approve.

faqs.q: Will an AI agent give legal advice to callers?
faqs.a: No. We configure every agent to gather information, book consultations and route people to your team, never to give legal advice. It identifies itself as an automated assistant and hands emergencies, existing clients and sensitive situations to a person immediately.

faqs.q: Is client information safe with AI tools?
faqs.a: It can be, when the tools are chosen and set up carefully. We use providers with business-grade data protections, keep client data out of public model training, limit what each agent can access, and follow ABA guidance on generative AI and your state bar's rules. Your firm keeps ownership of all data and workflows.

faqs.q: Do we need a new CRM?
faqs.a: Not always. Many firms already own a capable intake or practice management tool that is simply set up poorly. We review what you have, configure it properly if it fits, and help you choose a replacement only when it clearly holds the firm back.

faqs.q: Can you help with after-hours and weekend intake?
faqs.a: Yes. We design coverage plans that fit your practice, whether that is an answering service, an on-call rotation or automated text response with a fast human callback. Criminal defense and personal injury firms usually need the most coverage.

faqs.q: Will automated follow-up feel impersonal to clients?
faqs.a: It should not, if it is written well. We keep messages short, human and specific to the caller's situation, and every sequence hands off to a real person quickly. Automation handles reminders so your staff can spend time on actual conversations.

faqs.q: Does the AI agent replace my intake staff?
faqs.a: No. It covers the moments your team can't, like nights, weekends and busy lines, and handles routine questions and booking. Your staff get every transcript and take over whenever a person is needed.

faqs.q: How long does it take to set up?
faqs.a: Most firms go live in two to six weeks, depending on how many practice areas, locations and tools need to be connected.
